title: Authorize and transact collaboration records
responsibility: Resolve project membership and retry validated record changes against their current repository revision.

inputs.name: currentProject.actor
inputs.description: Verified actor whose membership is required.

inputs.name: currentProject.roles
inputs.description: Allowed roles; defaults to owner, commenter and viewer.

inputs.name: readRecords.deps
inputs.description: Repository dependency used to read and validate a snapshot.

inputs.name: transaction.deps
inputs.description: Repository dependency supporting read and compare-and-swap.

inputs.name: transaction.operation
inputs.description: Async operation that may mutate parsed records and return a result; can run again after write conflicts.

inputs.name: now.deps
inputs.description: Optional clock dependency; otherwise uses the current system date.

outputs.name: currentProject
outputs.description: Matching project with the actor’s membership role.

outputs.name: readRecords
outputs.description: Parsed records from the repository snapshot.

outputs.name: transaction
outputs.description: Operation result and revision; unchanged records avoid a write, and changed records retry at most five times.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: Injected date or a new Date from the system clock.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid actors or records, denied projects or roles and five unsuccessful write attempts; callback and repository errors propagate.
